root_cause: The integration bundle correctly allowed canonical content-publication obligations to close through runtime authority, but required-test then unconditionally executed the generic repository-artifact writeback guard, causing every generated daily blog candidate to fail despite the bundle being closure-ready.
prevention_rule: Runtime closure authority is valid only when the obligation matches an approved runtime prefix and every material path is within the explicit runtime publication allowlist.
Required test must treat the integration bundle as the single closure authority and must not reapply a contradictory repository-artifact guard to canonical runtime publication candidates.

tests: canonical content publication remains runtime-authority without duplicate repository learning
mixed blog + control-plane paths fall back to repository-artifacts and fail closed
required-test condition is bound to closure_authority
evidence.outcome: Pure daily blog candidates can reach the website lane; unrelated material changes cannot borrow the runtime-authority exemption.
